checks.name: Paystack callback parses reference and trxref and validates gateway
callback waits for authentication hydration before verification
callback distinguishes approved, processing, pending and failed results
temporary verification errors are not treated as declined payments
401/403 verification errors require sign-in rather than starting a second payment
processing state refreshes payment and subscription status
confirmed payment refreshes caches through the verification mutation
payment gateway query keys are account scoped
new payment initialization invalidates payment history
Paystack checkout URL is HTTPS and restricted to Paystack hosts
existing active payment reference is exposed without starting another payment
new checkout redirect requires both a valid reference and trusted authorization URL
